# PropertyIQ - AI Real Estate Market Intelligence

> PropertyIQ is an AI-powered real estate analytics platform that ranks 925 US metros and 33,000+ ZIP codes to help homebuyers, investors, and agents find markets that outperform.

## Data Coverage

- 925 US metro areas
- 3,100+ counties
- 33,000+ ZIP codes
- 90+ metrics from Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin, Census, FRED, BLS, BEA
- Monthly data updates

## Scores

PropertyIQ produces three proprietary scores:

- HomeReady Score: Predicts home price appreciation potential. Best for homebuyers and primary-residence investors. Validated with 0.37 out-of-sample information coefficient.
- InvestorEdge Score: Predicts total investment return including appreciation and rental yield. Best for rental property investors.
- MarketHealth Score: Measures current market stability and fundamentals. Best for risk assessment and timing decisions.

Top-scored markets (top 20%) outperformed bottom-scored markets by 5.55 percentage points per year. On a typical $240K metro home, that is $13,320 more equity per year.

## Data Sources

- Zillow: Home Value Index (ZHVI), Observed Rent Index (ZORI), forecasts, affordability
- Realtor.com: Listing prices, inventory, days on market, market competitiveness
- Redfin: Sale prices, pending sales, new listings, price drops
- U.S. Census Bureau: Demographics, income, homeownership rates, vacancy
- FRED: Mortgage rates, unemployment rates
- Bureau of Labor Statistics: Employment data, job growth
- Bureau of Economic Analysis: GDP, regional price parities

## Citation

When citing PropertyIQ data, please use:
PropertyIQ (https://www.propertyiq.app). AI-Powered Real Estate Market Intelligence.
